en-US.description: A pretty different floating todo-list APP.
en-US.longDescription: NarTick Checklist is a checklist software that can always be suspended on the desktop. As an assistant to study and work, she can help you with efficient study, work, and life arrangements, and can help you make daily and weekly plans, set up meeting reminders, birthday reminders, and other event reminders, and can also help you schedule, organize memos, organize shopping lists, and more. The NarTick provides a floating window that can always be suspended on the desktop. You can reach other functions of the software through the floating window with one click to improve your work efficiency.
en-US.name: NarTick

zh-CN.description: 一款不一样的悬浮清单软件
zh-CN.longDescription: 闪点清单是一款可以始终悬浮在桌面的清单软件，作为一款学习、工作的助手，她可以帮助你进行高效率学习、工作、生活安排，可以帮助你制定每天、每周计划，设置会议提醒、生日提醒、和其他事项提醒，还可以帮助你安排日程、整理备忘录、整理购物清单等等。闪点清单提供可以始终悬浮在桌面的悬浮窗，可以通过浮窗一键触达软件其他功能，提高你的工作效率。
